result.markdown: --- title: "Week 12: Review" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ## What you will learn this week * Review Assignment 1 * Announce winner of the forecasting competition * Discuss exam ## Pre-class activities Catch up on any exercises not yet done ## Slides for seminar Download pdf ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives **The key points to understand** - dynamic regression = regression model + ARIMA errors - the difference between regression errors and white-noise innovations - how to expand the model formula using lag/backshift notation - how to form forecast equations by replacing future errors with zero and future values with forecasts ::: rev - Complete Q2 and Q7 from Tutorial 11 and Q16 from Tutorial 8. ## Past exams * [[2023](exams/Exam2023.pdf)] [[2024](exams/Exam2024.pdf)][[2025](exams/Exam2025.pdf)] ## Assignments * [GA4](../assignments/G4.qmd) is due on Tuesday 26 May. ## Weekly quiz * Week 12 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400158) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5402255) — Due Wednesday 27 May.
